tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nag po chen po'i man ngag drug cu pa'i lhan thabs 'dod pa'i bdag po'i dpung gi srog gcod mtshon cha'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// shrī tsakra na tha puṇ+ya rat+na ya na maḥ rdo rje 'chang dbang sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mngag gzhug zhing bcu'i gshed/ /rdo rje gur dang dbyer med bla ma rgyal/ /dpal ldan dbang sngon lhun ltar brjid pa'i sku/ /dpal dbyangs 'brug stong ldir 'dra hūm̐ phaṭa gsung / /dpal 'bar bde gsal mi rtog gtum pa'i thugs/ /dpal gyi bstan skyong nag po chen po rgyal/ /gang zhig rdo rje gdan gyi sgo skyong las/ /gang der dor nas gzim spyil dkar po nas/ /gang yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrungs mdzad pa'i/ /gangs ljongs bstan srung dbang po spyi bos mchod/ /ma hā lo tsā ma ti kīrti yi/ /ma hā bhū mi paṇū'i shā sa na/ /ma hā kā la'i rak+ṣa e ka'i tsheg /ma ha sa mā ya la gnas der 'dud/ /kā la'i man ngag i ṣu pa ta'i dpung / /pra ṇo ts+tshe da sha ma li i dam/ /bir+ya bha ra'i sha trun mā dra'i phyir/ /ma ma hi ta ma nu cung zad bshad/ /zhes mchod tshig dam bca' sngon du btang nas/ de la 'dir/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri'i gtor sgrub kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i man ngag 'ga' zhig brjod par bya ste/ de la thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i tshe zlum gtor de nyid thod pa'i snod du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin zad mi shes par bsam/ sarba bigh+nān sogs brjod pa'i tshe de'i mtha' skor du dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po yi dwags kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas 'khod pa rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gsol bas thugs rgyud tshims shing rang gi sgrub grogs byed par bsam/

gang zhig 'byung po sogs brjod pa'i tshe rang thun mtshams kyi nag po chen po'i nga rgyal brtan pos de dag la bka' bsgos pas bka' las cung zad kyang 'da' bar mi nus shing sgrub grogs byed pa dang / gtor ma phyir dor te shā sa na dang sum bha ni brjod pa'i tshe sa phyogs de na gnas pa'i 'byung po mthu bo che 'dod pa'i bgegs byed cing mi 'dod pa'i sna 'dren pa de dag thams cad rang gi thugs kha nas sprul pa'i khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa rnams kyis phyi rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bskrad de mig tsam yang lta ba'i dbang med par bsam/ gnas yo byin rlabs kyi tshe badz+ra a mṛ ta dang swa bhā wa brjod pa'i dus tha mal gyi gnas khang 'di nyid mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas 'don cha bzhin gsal btab la rgya khyon snod bcud thams cad kyi nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsam/ rol chen dang bcas dha rmā ra ṇi dang pos ma dag pa'i skyon bsal/ gnyis pas mngon spyod drag po'i pho brang du byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas mchod yul spyan drangs shing mchod rdzas rnams kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /de nas bdag bskyed yan lag drug pa skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar gyi dmigs pa rnams bzung bde ba'i phyir 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang pos nyams rtogs gong 'phel dang / kun mkhyen chen po'i man ngag chos 'byung bzhin las/ 'on kyang bzlas pa'i tshe 'dir drag las la dmigs pa 'di bzhin bsgom pa gal che ste/ rang kyai rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ yum gyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du am̐ sngon po/ de gnyis kyi mthar nang nas rim pa bzhin du aṣ+ṭa dā+e wa pi tsu karta ri/ oṃ ring oṃ thung rnams kyi sngags phreng langs stabs su gnas pa kha dog nag po yig 'bru'i rang bzhin las rtsid skud sgril ba lta bu me stag phram phram gnas par gsal btab/

bzlas pa bgrang ba'i tshe/ rang kyai rdo rje'i rnam pa cung zad khro nyams kyi zhal brgyad ka nas sngags phreng 'brug sgra ltar bsgrags pas thog mar yum gyi am̐ nas sngags phreng byung / zhal nas thon yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim hūm̐ las sngags phreng thon/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad mar zhugs thugs ka'i am̐ la thim/ yang sngags phreng byung zhal nas thon pa sogs gong bzhin sngags phreng thon te lu gu brgyud du 'khor ba'i sngags phreng las 'od zer me'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad gzhob thul gyis bsregs par bsam mo/ /de nas bzlas pa bsdus te/ rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i thun mtshams kyi skur bzhengs pa'i bar rnam bshad nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin gsal btab/ de rjes srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma sgom tshul srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag dang bcas pa phyi khrid yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag gi khyad par gyi man ngag mde'u khar gdags pa khyad par gyi bzlog pa dang bcas bla ma dam pa'i gsung khrid yongs su rdzogs par sgom/ yang de tsam mi nus pa'am khrid kyang ji lta ba bzhin ma thob pa rnams kyis sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i brag rdzong ma'i nyams len gyi nang nas gsal ba bzhin gyi srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag rnams bsgom par bya zhing / der mi gsal ba 'ga' zhig 'dir brjod na/ thog mar skyabs 'gro'i skabs su rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal du gnas bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ gnas khang de nyid gnas yo byin brlabs kyi skabs su bsgom pa'i bar dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i 'og gzhi khrag gi rgya mtsho keng rus kyi dum bus gang ba/ logs rnams glo snying gi 'phan dzar gyis mdzes shing steng keng rus kyi thog phub pa/ mi mgo'i rwa ba'i kha mig rnams nas me lce 'bar zhing /

phyi rol nas rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lo ma 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i khrod du pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa nag po chen po mngon rtogs bzhin gsal ba'i dbu gtsug nas rim pa bzhin du pad nyi ro gdan la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams 'og ma'i spyi bor gong ma nag po chen po'i rnam pa can mtho brtsegs su bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun yal ga'i khrod du pad nyi bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan la kyai rdo rje yab yum lha mo brgyad bcas/ de'i g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab ji ltar rigs par bde mchog gsang 'dus phur pa 'jigs byed sogs rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / g.yas kyi yal ga'i khrod du shāka thub/ mar me mdzad/ 'od srung / gser thub la sogs pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis sangs rgyas dang / gangs can mtsho/ mi 'khrugs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs longs sku'i rnam pa can gyis sangs rgyas dang / bla ma gur mgon du gsal ba'i sku rgyab tu ngo bo de dag gi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i chos tshul rnams yin pa la/ rnam pa gdangs 'gag med po ti'i rnam pa brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu gdong dar khrag bun ne ba dang bcas pa/ g.yon gyi yal ga'i khrod byams pa 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa longs sku'i rnam pa can gyi byang sems dang gnas brtan bcu drug la sogs pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun/ e ka dza ṭī/ dpal ldan lha mo/ zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i dge 'dun rnams dang / gzhan yang yal ga lo ma 'bras bu la sogs pa'i khrod dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos srung nor lha dam can rgya mtsho sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bskor nas bzhugs pa'i shing sdong gi rtsa bar rang gi mdun du dgra 'dre byur gsum/

g.yas su pha ma spun zla/ mtha' skor kun tu rigs drug gi sems can khrom tshogs pa bzhin gnas pa thams cad lus pus mo btsugs/ snying khar thal mo sbyar/ gdong skyabs yul rnams la gyen du phyogs/ ngag skyabs 'gro'i sgra di ri ri 'don zhing sems kyis dus da res nas bzung ste ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du re sa dkon mchog gsum las gzhan du ma mchis pas thugs rjes gzigs shig snyam pa'i 'dun pa dung dung gtad par bsam la/ ngag tu bdag dang 'gro ba sogs dang / khyad par dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i tshe bla ma tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa la sems gtad la bdag gi lam ston pa po mdzod cig snyam pa dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe mdun gyi yi dam dang g.yas kyi sangs rgyas la sems gtad la bdag gi lam sna 'dren cing dngos grub stsol ba po mdzod cig snyam pa dang / dam pa'i chos rnams la zhes pa'i tshe/ rgyab kyi po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu la sems gtad la bdag gi lam dngos mdzod cig snyam pa dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la zhes pa'i tshe/ g.yon phyogs kyi byang sems kyi dge 'dun rnams dang mtha' skor kun nas bzhugs pa'i dam can rgya mtsho la bdag gi lam gyi bar chad sel bar mdzod cig snyam pa'i 'dun sems gtad la lan nyer gcig la sogs pa brjod/ de nas thal lo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs brjod pas skyabs yul dam pa de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po mtha' yas pa zhig spros/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan gyi gang zag bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag lus dag pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sems rtog med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te sems can thams cad rang rang gi zhing du gshegs/ slar mtha' skor du bzhugs pa'i dam can rgya mtsho 'od du zhu/

g.yon phyogs kyi dge 'dun la thim/ de rnams rgyab kyi chos༞ g.yas kyi sangs rgyas༞ mdun gyi yi dam rnams la rim bzhin thim/ yi dam rtsa ba'i bla ma nag po chen po'i thugs kar thim/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang nas yas rim gyi 'od du zhu mas rim gyi spyi bo nas thim/ mthar rtsa ba'i bla ma nag po chen po gdan mi ro pad nyi dpag bsam gyi shing dang bcas pa 'od sngon bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu/ rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ yang sems can gyi khams la bltas pa'i tshe da dung sems can dpag tu med pa zhig 'khor ba na lu gu brgyud du 'khor zhing gnas pas 'di thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bdag gis rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsrung 'khor tshul bzhin du bsgoms nas lam gyi bar chad bsal te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas nas sems can thams cad rnam dgrol thar pa'i lam la 'god snyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs lan gsum brjod pa'i sems bskyed bya/ gzhan dkyus bzhin las/ yang tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas yan lag bdun pa lan gsum phul ba'i mthar tshogs zhing rnams kyis/ rigs kyi bu khyed kyi gnas pa 'di la gnas na snyed pa'i mchog legs par snyed do/ /zhes gnang ba byin nas 'od du zhu ste rang la thim par bsam/ de nas shū n+ya tā'i sngags brjod pas tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad 'gags nas skad cig gis ngag tu brjod pa ltar rdo rje'i brag rdzong stong gsum gyi khyon ltar yangs shing gtor ma gru gsum mgo mjug ldog pa'i dbyibs can mtho zhing ngam chod pa me dpung dmar nag 'u ru ru 'bar ba'i steng du ngag 'don ltar chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag brag ri mkha' dang mnyam pa'i nang rak+ta'i rgya mtsho long long khol ba'i dbus nas skyes pa lta bu'i pad ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa'i chos 'byung gis kha bcad pa'i steng nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor tsha zhing rtsub pas pad+ma'i lte ba'i rgya khyon thams cad khyab pa/

de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje gang gis kyang gzhom gzhig mi nus par nyi shu par bsgoms pa'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las rdo rje che tshad rab dang chung tshad rdul phran la byas pa dpag tu med par spros/ de dag brag rdzong gi rtsa ba'i sa gzhi la rdo chal bsgrigs pa ltar 'khod pa rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i khor yug tu gyen la langs pa rwa ba/ de'i steng du phyur nyal ba drwa ba/ de steng gyen du langs rwa ba/ de steng phyur nyal ba drwa ba ste/ de yang nas yang du brtsegs pa'i rtse sogs gur gyi dbu ni bzhin zlum pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rtse dgu pa phyed pas tog gis mtshan pa ni gur/ de'i nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i bla re'i tshul du nam mkha' la lding ba ni rdo rje'i bla re/ phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa ste/ de lta bu'i srung 'khor bsgoms la brtan pa'i sngags lan gsum brjod pas gzi brjid nus mthu 'bar bar byin gyis brlabs/ yang 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūṃ maṃ hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo zhwa theb kha sbyar ba lta bu'i rtsibs bcu'i nang mdung so'i sbubs lta bu nang shin tu yangs shing phyi'i rtse ral gri so gnyis ma'i rnam pa 'dra ba rab tu rno zhing gcod pa'i ngar dang ldan pa/ yar rtse rdo rje'i bla re'i lte ba dang mar rtse 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la zug pa skad cig kyang mi gnas pa g.yas skor du shin tu 'khor bas 'khor ba mi mngon pa lta bu me'i rang bzhin can gsal btab la brtan pa'i sngags brjod pas nus mthu dang ldan par bsam/ de'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs kyi bar snang la pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi ro gdan steng du mgon po bskyed pa sogs dkyus bzhin thun mong ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang zhes pa rdo rje'i gur khang gi nang / thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gyi phyi zhes pa 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu'i mtha'i sa stong la dur khrod brgyad bsgom par bya ba yin cing /

rten dang brten par bcas pa'i ye shes pa thun mong ba'i srung 'khor gyi phyi'i nam mkha' la spyan drangs nas mchod pa phul ba'i rjes su bsgoms pa'i dam tshig sems dpa' rten dang brten par bcas pa la bstims pa yin zhing / dbang lha ni thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gyi nang rang gtso bor gsal ba'i smin mtshams nas 'dom gang 'jal ba'i sar mi bskyod pa gtso gyur gyi rigs lnga/ mā ma kī gtso gyur gyi yum bzhi/ byams pa gtso gyur gyi sems dpa' brgyad/ sgeg mo gtso gyur gyi lha mo brgyad/ gshin rje gshed gtso gyur gyi khro bcu ste/ dbang lha gdan gsum tshang ba khrom tshogs su spyan drangs/ gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas he ru ka re re byon te/ la las bum chu spyi bo nas blug la las cod paṇa bcings/ la las rdor dril gtad/ la las ming btags te dbang bskur/ yum bzhi'i rdo rje'i glu blang / byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mos mchod pa phul te dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor nas pad nyi gdan la mi bskyod pa sngon po longs sku'i cha byad ral pa'i thor lcogs rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhig gi rgyas btab/ dbang lha rnams kyang de la thim par bsam mo/ /de phyin chad kyi dmigs pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bsgoms pa'i mthar bha ya na tshar gsum gyi rjes su dmod mo thal rdeb kyi dmigs pa ni rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i lag pa gnyis gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i bar du dgra bgegs rnams bkug la thal mo brdabs pas phye mar btang zhing ro ma dor tshul byas pas sha khrag rus pa nang khrol thams cad 'og gi mgon po'i zhal du sib sib btab par bsam/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor phyi rigs 'jig rten skyong ba khro bcu rnams rang la bsdus nas rang nag po chen po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas srung 'khor gyi nang du gong gnas yo byin rlabs ltar gzhal yas khang gsal btab ste/

de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ thog mar dam rdzas gsum lnga bdun bcu gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs par rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / a mṛ tas bsang ba sogs gtor chog bzhin las dmigs pa ni gtor ma ji tsam bshams pa de dag kyang so sor thod pa stong gsum gyi khyon ltar yangs pa'i nang du ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yin pa la 'dir drag las la shis pas rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i phung po long long khol bar bsam la/ byin rlabs kyi sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ rgyun gtan gtor mgron mchod gtor gyi steng gi nam mkha' bskyed pa yin kyang da lam 'dir zor gtor rnams lhar bskyed dgos kyi stabs gtor zor gyi steng gi nam mkha' chos 'byung gru gsum sum brtsegs kyi nang du kyai rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs bcas bskyed cing spyan drangs dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ gtor ma 'bul tshul la dam rdzas bcu gcig tshar bshams na sngags grags blo ba'i gsung rgyun thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams kyis zin bris su mdzad pa ltar go rim bzhin dam rdzas dang po kyai rdo rje/ gnyis pa bde mchog gsum pa gur lcam dral/ bzhi pa zhal bzhi pa/ lnga pa dur khrod bdag po/ drug pa las mkhan lnga/ bdun pa dkar mo/ brgyad pa bdud rgyal/ dgu pa phur srung / bcu pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gnyis 'thus pa mdzad cing / bcu gcig pa ngos 'dzin bdag bskyed phur chung zhes pa'i tshe dam rdzas kyi mgor phur gtor the ba'i bcu gcig la ngos 'dzin kyang / deng sang phyag len la bcu gcig tshar 'di phur pa sgrub mchod/ phur bzlog mnga' gsol rnams las gzhan la mi mdzad la/ bdun tshar dang lnga tshar bshams pa 'di'ang mgon khang 'ga' zhig tu gtor gzhi'i gras la bzhugs pa ma gtogs phyag len phal cher la mi mdzad/

des na dam rdzas gtor ma gsum bsham phyag len 'di dar so che'i stabs/ de'i 'bul tshul ni dbus kyi dam rdzas yi dam bde kyai gnyis la 'bul/ g.yas kyi dam rdzas gur lcam dral zhal/ dur bdag las mgon/ dkar bdud rnams la 'bul/ g.yon gyi gtor ma phur srung / mkha' 'gro spyi/ gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul/ 'di skabs kyi dmigs pa ni/ dbus kyi dam rdzas de nyid kyai rdo rje'i lha tshogs la phul zhing mchod bstod phrin bcol grub ma thag gtor ma de nyid slar yang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin rlabs dran par byas la bde mchog lha tshogs la 'bul/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre shes par byas la/ g.yas g.yon gyi gtor ma gnyis kyang gtor mgron gong ma rnams la phul grub ma thag byin rlabs byas te 'og ma rnams la 'bul rgyu yin zhing 'di rnams 'phros don tsam dang / dngos gzhi kyai rdor la phul rjes de'i g.yas kyi nam mkhar 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig tsam gyis bsam pa cha dgur gyur pa la gtor ma 'bul tshul gyi dmigs pa rnams gtor chog bzhin/ de rjes mdun gyi chos 'byung tshom bu zor gtor bcas par rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul amṛ tas bsangs ba sogs gtor gzhung bzhin las/ dmigs pa ni/ mdun gyi chos 'byung tshom bu gtor ma rnams dbyer med pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad rten dang brten par bcas pa dang pu tra'i gtor ma ming sring gsum du ngag 'don ltar gsal btab cing / mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa la ye shes pa spyan drangs pa rnams sib sib thim pas gzi brjid lta bar mi bzod cing srid gsum 'joms pa'i mthu ldan du bsam pas nag po chen po lcam dral gyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu nas 'od zer phyung ste dam rdzas gtor ma gsol bas thugs rgyud tshim shing bdag gi las sgrub par bsam/ de'i g.yas kyi bar snang la zhal dang dur bdag gtor chog bzhin bskyed la gtor ma phul/

gong du bskyed pa'i gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gsum la'ang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te phul/ chos 'byung gi rtse mo'i lho zur du bran bdud kyi gtor ma bran bdud yab yum du bskyed la dam rdzas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te phul/ g.yon gyi nam mkha' dkar bdud phur srung rnams bskyed cing spyan drangs la gtor chog bzhin gtor ma dbul ba dang / gtor mgron rnams kyi mtha' skor kun tu mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi 'bul yul mkha' 'gro sde lnga phyogs skyong bcu zhing skyong brgyad la sogs pa 'dzam gling dur khrod phyogs mtshams brgyad/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa rnams la gtor ma 'bul zhing / gzhi bdag gtor ma'i 'bul yul ni/ 'dzam gling spyi'i sa bdag brtan ma dang / bod gangs can gyi gzhi bdag bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa gzhi bdag dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams gtor mgron gyi mtha' skor du byon nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam mo/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ yig brgya'i tshe mdun gyi nag po chen po lcam dral lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dang / zhal bzhi dur bdag bran bdud dkar bdud phur srung la sogs pa gtor mgron rnams kyi thugs kar hūm̐ yig dkar po de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas sku gzugs zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i gang / thugs ma mnyes pa dang khros pa sogs zhi nas bdag dang sbyin bdag sogs la dges shing brtse ba'i sku las 'od zer dkar po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'phros/ bdag sogs kyi lus thams cad khyab sdig sgrib nad gdon dam tshig nyams chags thams cad nyi ma shar bas mun pa sangs pa bzhin dag bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bsam la dmigs pa rtse gcig pas brgya rtsa bzlas/

yang rang thun mtshams kyi nag po chen por gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros/ mdun gyi yi dam bde kyai gnyis kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog de rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer nag po'i rnam par byung nas rang la thim pas rang sngar las kyang gzi brjid che bar gyur nas mgon po 'khor bcas bdag gam bka' las cung zad kyang 'da' bar mi nus shing ci bcol ba'i las thams cad bsgrub par bsams la/ de wa pi tsu brgya rtsa gcig bzla/ yang rang gi thugs kha nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros mdun gyi yi dam chos skyong thams cad kyi thugs kha'i sa bon la phog pas thugs zag med kyi bde bas mnyes/ de rnams kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dreg byed dam can rgya mtsho dang bcas pa la phog pas thugs zag med kyi bde bas mnyes/ thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu rnam pa 'od zer gyi tshul sprin 'thibs pa ltar byon nas mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams la thim/ de rnams kyang rang rang gi sku sngar las kyang 'od zer gzi brjid che bar gyur/ so so'i thugs kha nas byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par byon nas rang la thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag mthu stobs nus pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar rgyas/ bde chen gyi ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes par bsams la/ ma hā kā la stong phrag yi ge bcu gnyis ma sum brgya bzla/ yang rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od zer mthing nag me 'od 'phro ba mdung thung lta bu sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi nag po chen po'i thugs kar phog pas sku lus thams cad mes gang / de ma thag khro 'khrugs rngams pa'i zhabs gnyis drag tu brdabs pas srid pa gsum 'dar bar byas/

dgra bgegs kyi ro gdan de dmar myog myog btang / thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i pho nya las mkhan phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa stong gsum gang ba dpag tu med pa spros dgra bgegs gang na yod sar song nas khang zhing thams cad bshig kho rang 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mtshon cha la sogs pas gtubs nas lus dum bu brgya stong du btang sha khrag thams cad hab thob tu bzhes nas rnam shes kyi ngo bo ṇi yig ljang gu re lha so so'i thugs kar thim par bsams la shā sa na lnga brgya bzla/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa gong 'og rnams/ lha mo/ zhal/ dur bdag las mkhan/ bran bdud/ dkar bdud/ phur srung rnams la'ang so sor gtad la lha mo la ro ru sum brgya/ zhal la sngags thung sum brgya/ dur bdag la gṛ ha rā dza bcu gcig las mkhan mo la bod pa ro ru nyis brgya/ pho la bod pa ā li brgya/ pho mo gnyis kyi rbad bsad sum cu so gcig bran bdud kyi ma hā kā la/ dkar bdud kyi badz+ra shin+taṃ/ phur srung gi badz+ra kī la ya rnams bcu gcig re bzlas/ de'i mthar yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa phul bar bsams la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sngon du 'gro bas phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod sogs dkyus bzhin/ bshags pa phyag 'tshal sogs kyi rang lus nag po chen por gsal ba brgya stong du mar sprul nas bshags yul rnams kyi spyan sngar 'khod de bshags pa phul bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dam tshig nyams chags byang zhing dag nas smod 'bru re re yang mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med par gyur te/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi spyan lam du khyab pas thugs mnyes nas 'phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub cing / khyed thugs gsang ba sogs kyi tshe mgon po 'khor bcas kyis rang la dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i nus mthu khyad par can mgon po nyid dang dbyer med par stsal bar bsam mo/ /de nas bskang ba'i dmigs pa ni/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs skabs bsangs sbyangs gnas khang bskyed chog sogs dngos gzhi gang du bskyed zin pas gsal 'debs tsam dang khyad par de lta bu'i gnas khang shin tu yangs shing rgya che bar gtor mgron rnams mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i mdun du thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i dgra bgegs kyi thod pa bcad ma thag pa rlangs pa 'thul zhing stong gsum gyi khyon ltar yangs pa'i nang du khrag gi mchod yon rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil ba/

dbang po lnga'i me tog phung por spungs shing khrag rgyun 'dzag pa/ bsur chen gyi dud pas sa steng khyab pa/ zhun chen gyi sgron mes stong gsum gsal ba/ mkhris pa'i dri chab rgya mtshor 'khyil ba/ sha rus zhal zas ri ltar spungs pa/ rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra dbyangs nam mkha' khyab par sgrog pa/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa'i phung po zag med bdud rtsi rgya mtsho long long khol ba/ bya rta g.yag khyi lug mi nag lce spyang la sogs pa'i srog chags rnams dbang po tshang zhing drag po'i rgyan can gtum pa'i ngar skad sgrog pas snang srid thams cad khyab pa/ gzhan yang stag gzig go khrab gos dar la sogs pa mdor na thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas bskang gzhung nas bshad do cog thams cad kyis nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang zhing drag po'i las sgrub pa'i nus ldan du bsam/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kha sogs nas nag po chen po 'khor bcas kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon nas mdun gyi gtor zor nag po chen po 'khor bcas gsal ba la sib sib thim pas sku gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan zhing srid gsum thams cad 'dar phri li li g.yo ba dang / gsung hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro 'brug stong ltar bsgrags pas bdud snying ma lus tshal par 'gas shing rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las sgrub pa dang thugs bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang nas rnam pa dam nyams dgra bgegs la khro 'khrugs rngams pa'i tshul can du bsams la/ de thams cad la gdan pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi ro bcas phul ba brtan par bzhugs shing phrin las mdzad par bsam mo/ /de nas mgon po 'khor bcas kyi bskang ba'i gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa'i phung po zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can de nyid la ljags 'od kyi sbu gu zug ste gsol bas thugs rgyud tshims shing rnal 'byor pa'i phrin las sgrub par bsams la/

mgon po phur srung gi bar gyi gtor sngags rnams tshar gsum gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas phul/ phyi nang gi mchod/ 'dod don gsol ba rnams phyag len bzhin dang / de nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi mdun du gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'brub khrung nag po gru gsum pa rgya khyon rab tu yangs ba gting ring zhing zab pa gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa khrag mtsho rba rlabs 'khrug cing dug nad sprin ltar 'thib pa me rlung mar nag drag tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na mtshon cha'i ser chen 'bab cing thog gi bu yug 'tshub pa/ srog bdud las kyi bshan pa mang po dam nyams la rub cing rkan sgra rdeb pa snang srid lha srin sde brgyad stong gsum gang bas rgyob gsod 'jigs pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ thar med las kyi btson khang nag la 'thib pa'i nang du liṅga drug cu re lnga po thams cad kyang nri ljang gu las dgra bo/ pri dkar po las pho gdon pri ser po las mo gdon rnams lus rid cing skra gzings pa/ kha sna dang bshang gci'i chu lhug pa 'chor ba/ rdul gyis mog mog por gyur cing mig gting du shor ba kha nas khrag 'dzag pa/ sna nas rnag dang rna ba nas chu ser dang mig nas mchi ma'i rgyun 'dzag pa shu ba dang phol mig gis mgo lus med par khyab cing rnag khrag gi zeg chu 'dzag pa/ kha nas smre sngags dang ngu skad rang gi nyes pa byas pa thams cad sgrog cing mgon skyabs bral ba yi mug dang / dka' thub kyi nyams can 'dar yed yed gnas par bsam/ rang nag po chen po'i nga rgyal brtan pos thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer mthing nag tsha zhing rtsub pa me'i rang bzhin 'phros/ mdun gyi gtor zor mgon po 'khor dang bcas par gsal ba'i thugs khar phog pas rang dbang med par thugs rgyud bskul zhing rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi dam tshig rjes su dran te gtso 'khor thams chad kyi thugs kha nas rang 'dra'i pho nya las mkhan khro bo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa khro 'khrugs rngams pa'i phyag na lcags kyu/

zhags pa/ lcags sgrogs/ tho ba/ ral gri/ mda'/ mdung / spu gri logs na thogs pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par spros/ srid gsum thams cad gang bas de dag na gnas pa'i bstan pa spyi bye brag dang khyad par rnal 'byor ba dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren dmigs su gsal ba thams cad kyi snying gar lcags kyus btab ste khrid/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ mgrin par zhags pas bcings/ tho ba sogs thogs pa rnams kyis rgyob gsod la sogs pa'i sgra chen po sgrog cing / rgyab nas bsdigs bzhin pas ded/ kho rang gi las las grub pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zhig sa 'og nas 'tshub ste rang dbang med par bya spu rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin bkug nas rang gi mdun gyi 'brub khung nang gi liṅga rnams mthong ba dang / nye ba'i bsam pas der 'jug 'dod drag po dung dung yod par bsam la rdo rje dril bu hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas bzung nas/ dzaḥ na mo sogs dgug gzhug dkyus bzhin las gzugs dang liṅga 'di nyid la mchis par gyur cig ces pa'i rjes su shā sa na dang / lha mo'i ro ru/ las mgon mo'i bod pa ro ru tri tsa/ pho'i bod pa a li rnams kyi rjes su/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sarba sha trūṃ bigh+nān a kar+ṣa ya mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yang yang brjod cing / dmigs pa brtan pos dgug gzhug gi phyag rgya thog mar g.yas de nas g.yon de nas dbus rnams su bskor zhing liṅga'i steng du phab/ mthar dril bu gsil la khug cig phob cig ṇi yaṃ dzaḥ tri yaṃ dzaḥ zhes brjod pas mdun du bkug pa'i dgra bgegs de dag liṅga rnams la sib sib thim zhing / pho nya rnams kyis yan lag zhags pa dang lcags sgrog gis bcings shing tho bas brdungs pas 'byung bzhi'i khams nyams par byas shing / bsgral las ma grub kyi bar du skad cig tsam yang gzugs dang rnam shes mi 'bral zhing /

dbyer med du byas par bsam la lan gsum bya/ de nas lha dbye'i dmigs pa ni/ dzaḥn mo rje btsun sogs dang / srung bar byed pa'i lha thams cad dang phrol cig gi mthar rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas dgra bgegs de rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi nus mthu gnas skabs su bla mas dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i dus su gsal btab cing byin gyis rlabs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nus mthu thams cad liṅga rnams kyi gnas gsum nas/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po'i rnam par bsdus te bya tshang nas bya 'phur ba bzhin thogs med du byung nas rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin sngar las kyang gzi brjid nus mthu ches cher rgyas shing liṅga dgra bgegs su gsal ba'i lus de bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad dang bral zhing sdong po rnying pa nyi lhag gis khyer ba ltar nag hrul gyi song bar bsams la shā sa na/ lha mo'i ro ru/ mo'i rbad pa traka rak+sha nas/ trak+mo tra pa sha trūṃ mā ra ya'i bar dang / pho'i rbad pa dh+rīka nas/ mon bu khrag la 'jibs dza'i mthar/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sarba sha trūṃ big+nān sarba de wa rak+ṣa bi d+ya sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing lag g.yon dril bu gsil/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas gan rkyal du bslangs la gyen la 'degs tshul dang / yang sngags de nyid dang lag g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing dmigs pa ni rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas me mtshon khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med par spros te dgra bgegs de dag la srung skyob byed pa'i/ pho lha/ mo lha/ dgra lha/ zhang lha/ srog lus dbang thang klung rta bskyed pa'i lha thams cad phyi rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bskrad nas skad cig tsam yang 'khor mi nus par bsam/

yang sngags dang dmigs pa de nyid las/ lag g.yas rdo rje sdigs mdzub bcas pas liṅga'i mthar bskor bas de rnams mgon skyabs dang bral zhing mig hrig hrig 'dar yed yed bsam mo/ /skabs 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag kha sbyor dbye ba brgyad dang phyag 'tshal gyi dmigs pa sogs bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gdams pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag gis nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /'di skabs kyi phyag rgya rnams la bshad khungs shig ma mthong yang bla ma gong ma'i phyag len mthong brgyud zhig yin par kho bos sems so/ /de nas dpang gzug gi dmigs pa ni mdun gyi gtor zor nag po chen po 'khor bcas su gsal ba'i steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bar gyi cha la yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ mtha' skor kun tu dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa la dgra de'i nyes byas rnams bsgrags pas bden par dgongs shing rang gi grogs dang bla ma yi dam cung zad khro tshul gyis dgra bgegs sgrol ba la dgongs pa rtse gcig tu gtad pa dang / khyad par nag po chen po 'khor bcas dgra bgegs de nyid zhing bcu tshang nges su mkhyen te sngon gyi dam bca' dran pas rab tu khros pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog cing myur ba nyid du sgrol ba'i dam can 'dar shig shig bzhugs par bsams la/ 'das dang ma byon pa dang / dpal ldan mgon po'i bskul gyi mthar/ liṅga sgrol ba'i dmigs pa ni rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i phyag g.yas kyi gri gug des dgra bgegs rnams kyi srog rtsa skad cig tu bcad par bsams la liṅga thams cad la bskor bas de dag gi sems kyi rten bral rnam shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po gzung 'dzin dang bral ba zhig gri gug gi so la 'khril te rang gi zhal du zhugs rang skad cig tsam gyis he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/

sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pas skad cig la dgra bgegs rnams kyi rnam shes he ru ka ye shes kyi sku can du gyur pa la mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas la dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas 'ja' gur dang spos kyis stibs shing rol mo dang me tog gi char dpag tu med pa dang bcas te skad cig de nyid la 'og min gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam la phaṭa drag po brjod cing mig gyen du yun ring blta/ rang gi sems dang bsgral bya'i sems sgrol byed rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pa rnams ro gcig tu bsres nas 'dzin med blo 'das kyi ngang du cung zad mnyam par gzhag de nas dmigs yul rnams kyi lus rten las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i gdos bcas sha khrag rus pa'i phung po de nyid la las mkhan pho nya rnams kyis sha khrag nad dang mtshon cha'i char pa phab shang lang la sogs pas dum bur gtub cing bsgral bar bsams la/ shā sa na dang / lha mo la/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo sarba sha trūṃ big+nān mā ra ya ut+man+ta ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang / las mkhan mo'i bsad pa ma hā rak+sha tsit+ta srog trūṃ trūṃ nas sha trū mā ra ya'i bar dang / pho'i bsad pa nrir na rbad nas sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar gyi sngags rnams brjod cing gri gug gis liṅga 'og ma rnams kyi rkang pa g.yon pa nas btsams te gong ma rnams kyi spyi gtsug gi bar dum bur gtub cing ling ro de rnams sha yi phung po rus pa'i ri rab khrag gi rgya mtsho chen pos stong gsum gyi khyon gang bar bsams la/ phyi nang gsang ba la sogs brjod/ gsol kha'i dmigs pa ni ling ro'i snod gtor theb rnams kyang thod pa stong gsum gyi khyon ltar yangs pa'i nang du dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa'i phung po zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsams la gtor ma mgon po 'khor bcas su gsal ba'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste bcud thams cad gsol bar bsams la lag pa rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phyes te/

mgon po la shā sa na tshar lnga/ lha mo la oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī/ zhal la gtor sngags/ las mgon lnga la 'bod pa gnyis/ bran bdud la gtor sngags rnams tshar res phul/ phyi nang gi mchod/ 'phrin las bcol bas drag po'i las thams cad 'bad med du mdzad par bsams la/ gtor theb lnga tshar tshan pa gnyis su bshams nas res mos kyis tshar bcu gsum 'bul/ de'i mthar bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi dmigs pa 'don cha bzhin gtor ma'i mtha' skor du bshams pa'i mchod pa so so la sems gtad cing 'bul/ 'on kyang rak+ta'i mchod yon lha rnams kyi phyag dbang po'i me tog dbu dang sku gzugs kyi rgyan/ tshil chen dud pa shangs/ zhun chen sgron me spyan/ mkhris pa'i dri chab thugs/ sha rus kyi zhal zas ljags/ rkang gling thod rnga dril bu cang te sogs snyan/ g.yang gzhi bla re sogs gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ spyi rgyan mgul rgyan snyan rgyan dpung rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub se ral kha ste phyag rgya rnam drug sku lus/ sman raka gtor ma rnams zhal du phul bar bsam mo/ /bskang ba dbyings kyi dmigs pa ni/ de dang de'i tshig don la blo gtad pa tsam ma gtogs gsal kha mi snang / bzlog pa'i tshe rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros mdun gyi nag po chen po'i thugs kar phog pas zhabs sa la brdabs spyan 'khor rnams la hrig hrig gzigs pas las mkhan pho nya rnams shin tu khros par gyur te rang gi bka' nyan dregs pa sde brgyad kyi dmag dpung dang bcas pas rang la gnod byed kyi rbad 'dre rbod gtong sogs bsam sbyor ngan pa ji snyed mchis pa rnams byed pa po kho rang rnams kyi steng du bdud dang gshed du babs/ de rnams kyi srung ma rbad pa sogs thams cad kyang byed pa po rang la khros te rnal 'byor pas rbad pa'i dmag sna dgra bo'i yul du drangs nas rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam/ bka' bsgo'i tshe rang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams la spyan gsum gdangs mig tu gzigs shing tshig rnams 'brug stong ldir ba ltar bsgrags pas nag po chen po 'khor bcas shin tu 'jigs shing skrag

rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas rnams rjes su dran nas bstan la gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs stong gsum gang du gnas kyang sgrol bar bsam/ drag bskul tshe rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po tsha zhing rtsub pa me'i rang bzhin dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas la phog pas khro 'khrugs rngams pas stong gsum thams cad lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag gis bskang / de thams cad kyang seng ge sha la rngams pa ltar bstan dgra gang na yod pa'i sar mchongs shing lding zhing song ste/ dgra bo'i yul du khrag nad yams nad dug nad kyi char pa phab/ steng gi mi brgyud/ bar gyi nor brgyud/ 'og gi phyug brgyud/ khang zhing yul khyim sde dang bcas pa thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag de dag gi tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags thams cad 'od kyi rnam pas tshur bsdus ngo so dang bcas pas rang la byin pas rang gi tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags thams cad rgyas par bsam/ bstod pa'i tshe dbyangs gyer ba sogs kyi dus lha rnams kyang gzi brjid dang ldan zhing sku tshad kyang ri rab 'bum sde brtsegs pa ltar mthong zhing snang srid thams cad khyab/ ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i sgra bsgrags/ thugs zab gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor pa la mchog thun gyi dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ thun gtor 'bul zhing / spyi bstabs tshe/ gtor ma'i bcud lha tshogs rnams kyis gsol ba'i ro ma dug mtshon me dpung 'bar ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa las mkhan pho nya rnams kyi dgra yul du khyer nas mtshon cha'i ser chen phab pas bstan dgra 'khor bcas skad cig la 'joms par bsam/ mjug brtan bzhugs kyi skabs mdun du bskyed pa'i gtor zor tshom bu lhar gsal ba rnams drag las mthar ma phyin gyi bar brtan par bzhugs shing / zhal/

dur bdag dkar bdud sogs rten la brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams bris sku sogs kyi thugs khar bstim/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ go bsgo ba'i tshe rang he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyi rgyas btab par bsams la thun mong ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du spyod lam rnams byed par bsam mo/ /de nas zhag gnyis gsum la sogs par sgrub pa'i tshe/ gtor mgron bskyed skabs dmigs pa gsal 'debs tsam ma gtogs dngos gzhi thams cad gong du bkod pa ltar rdzogs par bsgom zhing / nub tha ma gtor ma 'phang ba'i tshe rdor glu yan gong dang 'dra zhing / de nas thog mar rang nyid la sde brgyad kyi zor mi 'byung zhing / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ngang gis 'du ba'i rdzas rang gi snying kha/ lte ba/ brla gnyis kyi steng du thal chen gyis byugs la/ skyes pa'i rus pa zhib par btags pa la sor mo lnga sbags te thal chen gyi steng du rjes mngon par rgyas btab ni thal chen gyi tshom bu/ yang smin ma gnyis dang snying ga'i steng du tshil chen zhu ba'i khu bas zor ba lta bu'i dbyibs bris pa zhag gi zo ris/ yang smin mtshams mkhur ba gnyis lkos ko rnams su rang byung khrag gi thig le byas pa khrag gi thig le rnams so sor bya ba'am/ yang na rdzas de dag lhan cig tu sbags pa ro sol dang bsres nas sna steng nas zhur 'then/ gzhan yang phod ka zhwa nag sogs drag po'i chas su zhugs nas/ kye bos so ma'i bskul gyi tshe gtor ma'i ye shes pa rnams nam mkhar gshegs te 'khor gyi dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i rgyab dpung du chas/ dam tshig pa gtor ma'i rang bzhin 'od du zhu ste skad cig tsam gyis bran bdud kyi gtor ma dug dang khrag nad dang yams nad kyi phung po me dpung 'bar ba'i khrod nas mtshon la sogs pa'i mtshon cha'i phung po 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa dang pu tra ming sring gsum gyi gtor ma dug dang khrag gi ser ba rdo'i char pa nad sna tshogs kyi phung po'i gseb nas shang lang spu gri dam shing la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan rab tu rno ba gcod pa'i ngar dang ldan par bsam/

gtor chen gri gug rtse gsum la sogs pa mtshon cha'i phung po chen por gyur pa'i phyi'i dug nad yams nad me dpung 'bar ba'i rang bzhin stong gsum skad cig la 'joms pa'i nus ldan du bsam/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi yams nad dug nad thams cad 'od zer dmar nag gi rnam par bsdus nas gtor zor mtshon cha sogs kyi phung por bsam pa la sib sib thim pas shin tu sra zhing 'thas pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi yang thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog pa'i nus ldan du bsam/ gzhan bka' bsgo/ gtor 'bul/ bzlog pa/ drag bskul sogs kyi dmigs pa rnams gong du bshad pa bzhin gsal btab/ khyad par rang nyid nag po chen por gsal ba'i bka' nyan gsung bstod kyi tshul du snang srid lha srin sde brgyad rang rang gi 'khor rnams kyi dmag dpung dang bcas te chas par bsam/ gtor ma 'phang sar slebs pa dang thog mar srid zhi'i mgron la gser skyems 'bul ba'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi lag tu khyer ba'i phud phor de nyid thod par bsam pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi gser skyems kha dog nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shes par bsam/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong phyogs skyong yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa la rang gi thugs ka nas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med par sprul nas thams cad kyi phyag tu re re phul bas gsol zhing bzhes nas thugs rgyud tshims nas 'das mgron rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pas rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing / dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mthu ldan du mdzad pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams kyang ko long phrag dog mi mthun pa'i gnod sems zhi nas rang gi grogs byed par bsams la/

dpal ldan rtsa brgyud sogs kyi gser skyems btang / de nas dpang gzug gi dmigs pa ni gong bzhin dang / zor lam dbye ba'i tshe rang nag po chen po'i nga rgyal brtan pos phyogs mtshams steng 'og na gnas pa'i sa bdag lha klu mthu bo che rnams la so so'i phyogs su sku zur cig par bka' bsgos pas/ rang rang so so'i phyogs su sku zur nas zor lam dgra bo'i yul du thal gyis ded par bsams la/ shā sa na dang / ro ru/ traka rak+sha/ dh+rig dh+rig ste pho mo'i rbad pa gnyis rnams bzla/ pho nya bskul ba'i dmigs pa ni so so'i tshig dang mthun par khyung chen bya nag khyi nag lce spyang mi nag rnams kyis stong gsum gang bar spros/ de dag na gnas pa'i bstan pa dang rnal 'byor pa la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad lcags kyus bkug zhags pas bcings/ mda' mdung la sogs pa'i mtshon cha rnams kyis bsdigs te gtor ma 'phang sar chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag rdul tshon gyis bris pa de nyid gnam lcags kyi 'brub khung yangs shing rgya che ba sogs bsgral las kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gsal btab pa'i nang du rang dbang med par bkug pa'i dgra bgegs de thams cad kyang lus rid pa sogs gong bzhin gsal btab pa'i snying kha'i dkyil na tshe dang bsod nams kyi rten yi ge a dkar po a'i khog par rnam shes kyi ngo bo ṇi ljang gu zhig gsal btab pho nya bskul rdzogs nas rang nag po chen por gsal ba de nyid dmag dpung dang bcas pa khro 'khrugs rngams pas dgra bgegs sgrol ba la chas par bsam te/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos bran bdud kyi gtor ma khrag nad sogs kyi phung por gyur pa de nyid phrag pa g.yas su 'phyar te dmigs pa rtse gcig pas shā sa na dang bran bdud kyi sngags kyi mthar khams gsum srog gi bdag po bran bdud gshin rje nag po yab yum 'khor bdud mgon bdun brgya dang gza' bdud bdun brgya dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad lo dang zla ba ma 'gyangs par myur du tshar gcod la rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su skyol cig

ces brjod la gtor ma drag tu rdab/ dmigs pa ni dgra bgegs de nyid kyi dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas nad rnams zhugs pa'i sems dran med du song zhing / lus me tog sad kyis khyer ba bzhin nag mog mog song bar bsam/ yang pu tra'i gtor ma khrag ser sogs su bsam pa de nyid phrag pa g.yas su 'phyar la dmigs pa brtan pos ma hā rak+ṣa tsit+ta srog la truṃ truṃ sogs dang / ṇir gri na rbad sogs las mgon pho mo'i bsad sngags kyi mthar gsod byed las kyi mgon po mon pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pas bdag cag dpon slob sogs bran bdud kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi dmod bcol dang bcas gtor ma drag tu brdabs pas dgra bgegs kyi lus brdung btsog yan lag thams cad dum bu dum bur gtubs myal myal bsad par bsam/ de nas gtor chen gri gug rtse gsum sogs mtshon cha'i phung po nad dang dug gi rang bzhin du gsal ba de nyid phrag pa g.yas su 'phyar te mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma/ bcu gnyis ma rnams dang lha mo'i shrī ya de wi/ las mgon gyi 'bod rbad bsad gsum gyi mthar/ suṃ trika rak+ṣa bh+yo/ thib thib tsakra bh+yo/ snying kha rag dun+taṃ bh+yo/ rbad rbad tri na shig shig se na gtubs gtubs/ kha rag rbad/ dum bu bh+yo/ badz+ra tsa tri rak+sha tsa tir mā ra ya rbad bh+yo bzlog hūm̐ bh+yo/ dpal ldan ma hā kā la gur gyi mgon po yum chen e ka dza ṭī/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' bsdod pu tra ming sring / bran bdud gshin rje nag po/ las byed ru 'dren sde bzhi/ gdong brnyan sgo ma rnam bzhi/ 'bar ba ghaṇ+ḍi'i lha tshogs/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa/ ye shes gsal ba'i spyan dang ldan zhing / rdzu 'phrul myur ba'i zhabs dang ldan pa/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/

brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu/ cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sngon rdo rje 'chang chen po dang / ston pa dpal shākya thub pa la sogs pa dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal ldan gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ grub pa thob pa'i slob dpon bram ze mchog sred la sogs pa 'phags yul khams grub rgya mtsho lo chen rin chen bzang po sogs bod yul bstan pa'i gsal byed khyad par du yang rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang / bye brag tu sngags 'chang bdud kyi stobs 'phrog ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgya mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar srog gi snying po phul zhing mna' dor dam bcas dam tshig gi rdo rje spyi bor bzhag bdud rtsi a mṛ ta lce la byin te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gang na gnas pa na/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyang de na gnas pa yin no/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gang na gnas pa na/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyang de na gnas pa yin no/ /gsang ba'i snying po gang na gnas pa na/ sngags bdag dregs pa'i tshogs kyang de na gnas pa yin no/ /chos skyong bstan pa mi srung ci zhig srung / dam can dam la mi gnas ci la gnas/ sngags bdag dgra bgegs mi sgrol ci zhig sgrol/ su la mi re khyod la re/ su la mi ltos khyod la ltos/ rgyal mtshan du khyed 'dzugs/ phrag la khyed khur/ dmag dpung du khyed bskyed/ dpa' dar du khyed 'phyar ba yin pas sngon gyi dam tshig las ma 'da' bar sdang byed dgra la mthu ma chung / gnod byed bgegs la rtsal ma zhan/

bcol pa'i las la bang ma bul/ mthu dang rtsal ma zhan/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig yul khyim dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod cig mi nor phyugs gsum gyi gnyer mdzod cig yul du 'khor srungs shig byes su rkyen bzlog cig phyi nang gi bar chad srungs cig bcol pa'i las gyis shig sgrub pa'i rtags phyungs shig 'phrin las mngon du gyis shig rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzod cig khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshigs pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma'i sku dgra byed pa sogs bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa spyi dang bye brag tu yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che de 'dzin gdung brgyud lha sde mi sde zhing khang yul khyim sde dang bcas pa thams cad la bsam sbyor phyin ci log 'chang ba'i sgo nas snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra bcom par byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs dam nyams sdig can 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlog cig bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i kha yis ma nyes/ lag gis ma nyes/ spyod pas ma nyes/ dam nyams sdig can 'di dag gis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje chen po rnams kyi sku la bsdos so/ /rigs la bsnyags so/ /bstan pa bshig go /'di las kyi rlung dmar gyis rgyab nas phul cig 'jigs pa'i mun nag gis mdun nas bsus shig gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas chod cig sa yi rten phur 'og nas phyungs shig dkon pa'i tshe srog dang phrol shig tshe'i 'du byed skums shig kha ru lag pa chug cig khong nas snying mar phyungs shig mig 'bras thang la lhungs shig 'chi bdag gi bdud thong zhig 'khor shig cig tshang krugs shig mgo khos shig lus skems shig sgo'i nor dang phrol cig mchan gyi bu dang phrol cig yul dang khang khyim bshig cig

zhing gi skye rgyud chod cig yar gyi pha brgyud chod cig mar gyi bu brgyud chod cig rtsad nas chod cig drungs nas phyungs shig glo bur ye 'drog thong zhig smyo 'bog dang brgyal nad thong zhig ltas ngan dang cho 'phrul thong zhig mna' sdoms dang dme 'khrug thong zhig lo dang zla bar ma bzhag cig zhag dang za ma la rtags mtshan phyungs shig nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ 'jig rten phyi ma la dus ma 'debs/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i skye shi la khungs ma 'byin/ las kyi dbang btsan po zhes tha snyad ma 'dogs par rtags dang mtshan ma drag po myur du mngon sum du phyungs shig khyed la gtang rag gnyan po gtong ngo / /ye shes kyi spyan 'byed do/ /thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul lo/ /bcol pa'i las la 'bras bu mchis pas mdzod cig ces brjod la gtor ma kha phub drag tu brdab/ dmigs pa ni dgra bgegs de nyid kyi lus dum bu brgya stong du gas snying dkyil na yod pa'i tshe dang bsod nams kyi rten a dkar po de rang gi snying gar thim pas tshe dang bsod nams rgyas ṇi de nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba bzhin song nas mi bskyod rgyal ba'i zhing du sangs rgyas par bsam la 'dzin med kyi ngang du bzhag de nas bla ma gong ma'i bzhugs/ 'bol na bza' 'am rang gi chos gos sam mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi pags pa'am/ g.yab dar nag po'am phod ka'i thu ba g.yas pa sa la brdab par bshad kyang da lta gtor bzlog mdzad pa po thams cad kyi phyag len la mdzad pa ltar gtor slang la lan gsum brdab pas gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa mgon po 'khor bcas dregs byed kyi dmag dpung dang bcas pa dgra bo'i yul du song ste bstan dgra 'khor dang bcas pa kha phung gtan brlag tu ma song bar mi 'byon par bsam/ de nas bsrung 'khor sgom pa ni/ skad cig gis rdo rje'i rwa gur drwa ba bla re rnams gsal lam gyis btab la rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs dang /

/thun mong min pa'i bsam 'phel dbang rgyal ni/ /dad dung 'dun pas legs blangs rgyal mtshan rtser/ /nyer bkod phrin las 'od 'bar mthu chen las/ /bdud dpung mun nag sa 'og rim kun song / /skal bzang slob ma'i blo gros snang ba rgyas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs bcu 'phel ba'i gtam 'di ngo mtshar che/ /chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho yis/ /rtsang bzlog mu stegs byed la yod ces thos/ /dgra chos zhes pa g.yung drung bon gyi yin/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi gshin rje mkhan por grags/ /zhes sogs zur za'i tshig 'ga' gsung mod kyi/ /gong ma gnyis kyi khungs ni ci yin kyang / /drug cu 'di la yig rnying dam pa yis/ /mdzad pa'i yig cha sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams la/ /mgon po nyid kyis mngon sum gnang ba ltar/ /gdan sa chen po'i dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /bde mchog pho brang blo sding ngo mtshar can/ /gang der ma hā kā la'i chos skor la/ /gzigs rtogs mdzad tshe sngon gyi dpe rnying khrod/ /shog bu dpe 'bol logs la lcags smyug gis/ /'di yi yig rnying gsal kha can bris pa/ /legs par gzigs tshe dga' spro dpag med kyis/ /bris lan lha dbang rdo rje rtsom par mdzad/ /de lta'i mthu las tshar chen chos kyi rje/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa'i ltas/ /snyan brgyud chos kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /dbang phyug rab brtan la sogs 'khrul zhig gi /skyes chen dam pa du ma'i zhal sgo las/ /gdung rgyud thun mong min pa'i gser chos rnams/ /sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' mtshan can gyis/ /yongs rdzogs gsan pa'i rten 'brel de nas 'grigs/ /de ltar bas na rang re rjes 'jug rnams/ /grub mtha' ngan pas blo kha ma bsgyur bar/ /sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi gsung rab dang / /rjes 'brel bstan 'dzin ngor rdzong gong dkar ba/ /snyan brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po tshar pa rje/

/khyad par rje btsun rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa/ /sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa gang / /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' bsod nams kyi/ /zhal gyi pad rdzing mchog la legs byon pa'i/ /legs bshad rnam mang 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /yang zab bdud rtsi'i nying khu myong gyis la/ /skal bzang slob bu'i tshogs la legs bshad kyi/ /ngo mtshar phreng ba byin la bstan pa spel/ /khyad par nag po'i man ngag drug cu pa'i/ /gtor bzlog khungs 'di gzhan la mi smon par/ /legs bshad lha dbang rdo rje'i mgrin pa yi/ /rgyan du mdzes par byas na gsal bar smos/ /lhag bsam rab dkar dri ba mdzad pa po'i/ /thugs dgongs rdzogs shing rjes 'jug bstan 'dzin gyi/ /rang cag rnams kyis man ngag mchog 'di la/ /rtsod pa'i mdud pa rang zhir grol bar 'gyur/ /de ltar nag po chen po'i chos skor las/ /'dir ni dmigs pa'i gnad 'ga' bstan pa'i dges/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bzhed gzhung dri med rgyun/ /dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga'i lhan thabs 'dod pa'i bdag po'i dpung gi srog gcod mtshon cha'i phreng ba 'di yang sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi rigs dbon sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gdan sa chen po 'di nyid du drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog lo bstar gyi gnang rgyun 'dug pa ltar de skabs kyi zor 'dzin pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas nye bar bkod pa 'dis kyang sngags 'chang chos kyi rje ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi zab dgongs chos kyi dbyings su song nas skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs drung du skye zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i skal pa bzang po la spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //ces pa'i yi ge pa ni bsod nams 'od zer dang slad kyi bri ba po tshe ring nas bgyis pa/
